_comment: Seed topic list — sourced from strategy-notes/2026-08-filming-source-material.md in the kbt-ai repo. These are candidates based on existing market understanding, NOT validated search/consumption data. demandScore starts at 0 for every topic; the demand-scoring agent (lib/topic-agent.js) is what replaces these zeros with real scores from competitor-channel research. Until that's run, topic-ranker.js's coverage-first sort still works correctly (all topics tied at demandScore 0 just fall through to the staleness tie-break, which is fine for an unscored list). Updated 2026-08-28: added an 'angle' field ('pain-avoidance' | 'pleasure-seeking') to every topic, and 12 new pleasure-seeking topics (opportunity-1..12) grounded in live YouTube autocomplete research into AI monetization/leverage/optimization search terms (see functions/api/topics/discover.js's SEED_QUERIES comment for the research log) — the original 42 skewed entirely pain-avoidance, which undersells the real audience segment searching AI content from an opportunity/leverage angle rather than a problem angle.
